Store FE, from 500,000 to 256,000,000 by tier, and keep it when broken. The lights on top show how full they are.
Its top slot drains a Battery into the cell, the bottom one charges it.
They take in and give out 512, 2,048, 16,384 and 262,144 FE/t: an Arcforged cell keeps up with an Arcforged Energy Conduit.
